name: Sixteen-lane joint up/gate reduction
description: Changes only reduction width from eight to sixteen lanes per output row and four output rows per64threadgroup. Uses the correctness-passed native-style exact half FP4 decode. Targets the measured up/gate region (0.379ms/call,46.7% of one sampled isolated expert), testing a different work/register/coalescing balance without a hardware-cause claim. Original MXFP4 weights/scales/routes, BF16 epilogue, native down and prefill fallback remain. No copy, conversion or requantization.
